description: This file provides helper functions and interfaces for proactive messaging in a QQ bot, including managing known users, sending messages, and broadcasting. It interacts with external modules for API calls, configuration, and logging.

methods.name: getKnownUser
methods.description: Looks up a known user entry, acting as an adapter for the old proactive API shape.

methods.name: listKnownUsers
methods.description: Lists known users with optional filtering and sorting.

methods.name: clearKnownUsers
methods.description: Clears all known users, optionally scoped to a specific account.

methods.name: sendProactive
methods.description: Resolves account config and sends a proactive message, supporting text and images.

methods.name: sendBulkProactiveMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to multiple recipients with rate limiting.

methods.name: broadcastMessage
methods.description: Broadcasts a message to all known users, with optional filtering.

methods.name: sendProactiveMessageDirect
methods.description: Sends a proactive message directly using a resolved account.

methods.name: getKnownUsersStats
methods.description: Returns counts of known users by type for a given account.
